title: Apple Foundation Models
summary: Apple Foundation Models (AFM) is Apple's framework for running AI models directly on-device, enabling privacy-preserving inference using Apple Silicon's Neural Engine. The framework powers Apple Intelligence features and provides developers tools to integrate local AI capabilities into iOS, macOS, and other Apple platform applications.
problem_solved: Enables on-device AI inference while keeping user data private by eliminating the need to send sensitive information to cloud servers.
why_valuable: Provides enterprise-grade privacy for AI applications while leveraging Apple Silicon's powerful Neural Engine for efficient, low-latency model execution.
